title: Understand Slope as Rate of Change Core Test
description: Interpret slope as a constant rate of change in tables, graphs, equations, and contexts.

questions.questionText: In a trail distance situation, y changes by 4 miles while x changes by 6 hours. What is the rate of change?
questions.explanation: Slope and rate of change both mean change in y divided by change in x.
